title: ValueStream demos
headline: Walk into a working practice.
lede: Each demo is a complete, running copy of the product - a made-up practice with its clients and matters, work in progress and a team at work. Sign in with a code sent to your email and you join it as a senior member. Open files, change numbers, record the day's work. Nothing you do can break it.
clock_note: Every night the demos are put back to their clean sample data. Anything you added or changed is wiped then - so explore freely.
clock_now: Being reset right now - back in a minute.
steps: Your name and email. A 6-digit code reaches your inbox - no password, no card.
You join the demo practice as a senior member, with real-looking clients, matters and work under way.
Do the day's work - file a return, record a hearing. The practice is yours until tonight's reset.

trust: No real client's information is in these demos - every name, PAN and figure is made up.
Your changes last until the nightly reset, then the firm starts fresh for the next visitor.
We use it only to send your sign-in code and to know who visited.
